_meta.method: Residential baseline + commercial DCFC benchmark. Fuel = most-sold grade. EV tariff = dominant home slab; DCFC = median 60kW+ price. Sources: MERC/MSEDCL, EIA, BNetzA, EVN, PLN, TKDN docs. Fleet override allowed in UI.
_meta.sources: EIA API (US), MERC/MSEDCL PDFs (IN-MH), DERC (IN-DL), BNetzA, CRE, Ofgem, NEA, METI, PLN, EVN, EPPO, ANEEL, DEWA, SE, AER, ACM, NVE, Eskom, CRE-MX, DOE-PH, NERC-NG, EPDK, KPX. Homepage receipts in generator.py TARIFF_SOURCES; deep circular links in refresh-tariffs.py SOURCES.
_meta.realtime_policy: Snapshots with 45-day SLA + user override. No per-second websockets — cars are not bought on tick data.
